{{Quote|Any wonder the kid doesn't talk? If you'd seen what he's seen?|A Rebel|<ref name="Silent" />}}
'''A'kazz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Schenor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was the sole survivor of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-backed [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|attack]] on a [[Schenor research station]]. A'kazz was returned to the Schenor [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rhamsis Callo]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s at the urging of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well, the kid must've seen something important, or Skywalker wouldn't be sending us half-way across the galaxy to deliver him to his people.|A Rebel|<ref name="Silent" />}}
A'kazz was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Schenor]] living with his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] and several dozen [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] aboard a [[Schenor research station|research station]]. Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Space station/Legends|station]] was [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|attacked]] by a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in the employ of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The station sent out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]], and [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] authorized a mission to investigate. As they arrived, they found the mercenaries in combat with the Schenor, and joined the [[Lightfight|fight]] until an Imperial [[Gunboat/Legends|gunboat]] pinned down the Alliance [[operative]]s and evacuated the mercenaries. When the Alliance force investigated the scene, they found near total destruction and single survivor; A'kazz. Rendered mute by witnessing the death of his parents and everyone else, the Alliance operatives took him to an Alliance base when he was questioned by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in a private session. After the meeting, Skywalker believed that if A'kazz returned to the Schenor [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rhamsis Callo]], then his testimony to his [[nest-guild]] could encourage the Schenor to abandon their neutrality in the Galactic Civil War and side with the Alliance. The operatives who had rescued A'kazz were directed to take him to Rhamsis Callo.<ref name="Silent" />

Landing at [[Chafflock]] on Rhamsis Callo, the operatives took A'Kazz to his [[nest-guildmaster]], [[B'karitz]], by [[reaction car]], encountering several Imperial attempts at stopping them along the way, including vehicle chases and ambushes at their overnight lodgings. At first, B'karitz believed that the Alliance team were hostile, and were ransoming A'kazz to them. Once convinced of their good intentions, he interrogated A'kazz via a [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] trance and learned the truth of the Imperials' involvement in the attack on the research station. With A'kazz's testimony, B'kartiz took his [[nest-warrior]]s to an under-construction [[Unidentified Imperial base (Rhamsis Callo)|base]] that was being built under the aegis of a [[Schenor/Imperial treaty|treaty]] signed by the Empire and the Schenor government. As an influential noble from a powerful province, B'kartiz declared the treaty null and void and ordered the Empire off Rhamsis Callo.<ref name="Silent" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Aside from having seen troopers murder his parents and a couple dozen other colonists, being stuck inside a spaceship with a bunch of us ugly aliens might be making him nervous.|A Rebel|<ref name="Silent" />}}
A'kazz was a juvenile member of the Schenor species who was shocked into muteness by witnessing the murder of the entire Schenor colony at the research station he lived at, including his parents. He formed an attachment with one of the Alliance operatives who rescued him, who happened to be the most cynical and hard-hearted of the team. He would stare at the operative with his big yellow eyes.<ref name="Silent" />
